attestations.panel.heading: Signed audience statements
attestations.panel.description: Each ended stream gets a statement signed by this instance: verified viewers, what was left out of your counts, and how the stream was delivered. Sponsors can check it without trusting a dashboard.
attestations.panel.empty.title: No signed statements yet
attestations.panel.empty.description: A stream's statement shows here 24 hours after it ends.
attestations.entry.title: Statement {seq}
attestations.entry.unreadable: This statement could not be read.
attestations.entry.statementHint: Give this to a sponsor; they can check it on the verifier page.
attestations.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
attestations.share.createFailed: The share link could not be created.
attestations.share.urlHint: Shown once. Anyone with this link sees the excluded breakdown until it expires or you revoke it.
attestations.share.heading: Share links
attestations.share.loadFailed: Share links didn't load. Refresh the page to retry.
attestations.share.revokeDescription: Whoever has the link can no longer see the breakdown. The signed statement itself stays valid.
attestations.share.revokeFailed: The share link could not be revoked.
attestations.verify.title: Verify an audience statement
attestations.verify.intro: Paste a signed statement or a window of statements. This page checks the signature against this instance's published keys and the chain that links the statements.
attestations.verify.inputHint: The JSON you were given: one statement with a payload and a signature, or a list of them.
attestations.verify.unparsable: This is not a signed statement. Paste the JSON exactly as you received it.
attestations.verify.failed: The check couldn't run. Try again in a few minutes.
attestations.verify.validDescription: This statement was signed by the instance below and has not been changed since.
attestations.verify.notProof: Excluded traffic is not proof of wrongdoing. It is watching this instance could not count as verified, for the reasons the creator can share.
attestations.verify.problem.malformed: It is not a well-formed statement.
attestations.verify.problem.non_canonica: The statement was re-encoded after it was signed.
attestations.verify.problem.bad_signatur: The signature does not match: the statement was changed or signed by someone else.
attestations.verify.problem.kid_mismatch: The key it names does not match the published key.
attestations.verify.problem.unknown_kid: It was not signed by any key this instance has published.
attestations.verify.problem.compromised_: It was signed by a key this instance has withdrawn. Ask the creator for the re-signed statement.
attestations.verify.problem.wrong_origin: It was signed for another instance. Check it there.
attestations.verify.problem.chain_break: The statements do not form an unbroken chain, or one of them was never published here.
attestations.verify.problem.superseded: The signature is valid, but a later statement replaces this one. Ask the creator for the current statement.
